_meta.name: Time watching television
_meta.source: BLS American Time Use Survey Table A-1 and public API
_meta.note: All persons age 15+, average hours per day including people who did not perform the activity. No 2020 annual estimate was published because pandemic-related collection gaps prevented a comparable annual estimate.
_meta.annualRule: Annual average, all days of week; 2020 omitted.
_meta.breaks: 2020 is absent because ATUS data collection was suspended during part of the year; activity and population definitions follow each annual table.
